## Maenad Dragon (CR 13)

**XP** 25,600  
CE Large dragon (chaotic, human and/or orc)  
**Init** +6 **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +23  
**Aura** Dark Banner (100 ft., evil humanoids/monstrous humanoids become immune to fear and charm, gain +3 morale bonus on attacks)  


**Defense**


**AC** 25, touch 12, flat-footed 22 (+7 armor, +2 Dex, +1 dodge, +6 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 304 (16d12+112)  
**Regen** 5 (lawful, fire)  
**Fort** +16, **Ref** +14, **Will** +14; **Resist** acid 10, sonic 15  
**Immune** charm, fear, poison, sleep; **SR** 16  


**Offense**


**Speed** 60 ft., fly 240 ft. (good)  
**Melee** chaotic combat (1d6+1 melee attacks per round, roll 1d6 to determine each attack, see chaotic combat below)  
**Ranged** up to two +17 sonic cries (4d6 sonic plus deafened for 1d6 rounds (Fort DC 24 negates), 20/x2, 30 ft. range increment)  
**Special Attacks** rend (two claw attacks of any type, 3d6+6 slashing)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 22, **Dex** 15, **Con** 23, **Int** 11, **Wis** 19, **Cha** 18  
**Base Atk** +16; **CMB** +23; **CMD** 35  
**Feats** Cleave, Combat Reflexes, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Flyby Attack, Great Cleave, Hover, Improved Initiative, Spring Attack, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Whirlwind Attack, [Weapon Focus (combat)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Lightning Reflexes](../../rules/feats/lightning-reflexes.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (combat), Lightning Reflexes.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +21, Fly +27, Intimidate +23, Knowledge (local) +19, Perception +23, Survival +23  
**Languages** Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Goblin, Gnoll, Orc  
**Gear** +1 breastplate of light fortification  


**Special Abilities**


**Chaotic Combat (Ex)** The maenad dragon fights without training, depending solely on luck, instinct and her innate physical gifts to see her through any battle. Each round, roll 1d6+1 to determine how many attacks the maenad dragon may make that round. Then roll d6 to determine which melee attack option the maenad dragon actually makes. She may substitute up to two melee attacks per round with ranged attacks instead.
